memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Then Joseph said to Pharaoh, 'The dreams of Pharaoh are one and the same. God has revealed to Pharaoh what he is about to do. The seven good cows are seven years, and the seven good heads of grain are seven years; it is one and the same dream. The seven lean, ugly cows that came up afterward are seven years, and so are the seven worthless heads of grain scorched by the east wind: They are seven years of famine.'" - Gen 41:25-27 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Joseph unfolds the meaning: both dreams are one message from God. The seven fat cows and full heads of grain are seven years of abundance; the seven lean cows and withered heads are seven years of famine to follow. And notice how Joseph frames it: "God has revealed to Pharaoh what he is about to do." The dreams were not random; they were God graciously giving warning of what lay ahead.

Two things stand out. First, God knows the future completely. Seven years of plenty and seven of famine were already settled in God's plan before a single one had come. The future that is a total mystery to us is fully known to Him. Nothing surprises God; nothing catches Him off guard.

Second, God warns in mercy. He did not have to reveal the coming famine. But in kindness, He gave Pharaoh advance notice so that lives could be saved. This is how our God often works — He warns before judgment falls, that people might prepare and be spared. His warnings are acts of grace.

We can rest in a God who holds the future in His hands and who warns us in love. The Scriptures are full of His gracious warnings — about sin, about judgment, about the shortness of life — all given so that we might turn to Him and be saved. Do not ignore God's warnings; they are the mercy of a God who knows what is coming and wants to prepare us.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do I rest in the truth that God fully knows my future?
2. Am I heeding God's gracious warnings, or ignoring them?
3. How does God's foreknowledge give me peace?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, You hold the future fully in Your hands, and You warn Your people in love. Help me to rest in Your foreknowledge and to heed Your gracious warnings, turning to You and being ready. Amen.
